name: Kajio Saeko
source:
26 years old and a senior newscaster.

She is a senior newscaster in the GUIL-TV news department. She is a beautiful woman with glasses who exudes an intellectual atmosphere.

She as a great body and wears brand-name clothes with great sense of style. She is a cool beauty with a slightly cold attitude.

Although she has been subbing for Mariko on "Prime Time News", she has proven herself to be a very capable newscaster.

Since the beginning of "Prime Time News," she has been distant from Mariko, and Mariko believes that Saeko is jealous of her being the main newscaster.

From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=180&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
